''For a summary of all translated versions of The Wheel of Time see [[The Wheel of Time translations]].''

'''The Wheel of Time''' in Norwegian is '''Tidshjulet'''. The books were published in Norway by Tiden Norsk Forlag, but did not translate the last three volumes of the series that were completed by Brandon Sanderson. [[New Spring]] was also published in Norwegian in 2005.

The translators for the series were Berit H. Løken (NS, TFOH, ACOS), Olaf Havnes (TEOTW), Jens Erik Røsåsen (TGH, TDR, TSR) and Morten Hansen (LOC, TPOD, WH, COT, KOD).

==Book Titles==

The titles for the unpublished titles are taken from the Norwegian wikipedia article on ''The Wheel of Time''.[https://no.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tidshjulet]. Some of the books were initially split into multiple parts, but were later published in a single volume. Dates for each given.

Prequel: '''New Spring''' - Ung vår
